title: Accuracy and absence of trace failures
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let a trace be a finite list of estimate records on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, let the target be a sign-valued Boolean function on that cube, and let the rational threshold $\tau$ satisfy $0<\tau\leq 1$. The trace has no record whose estimate differs from the corresponding restricted Fourier weight by at least $\tau^2/4$ if and only if every record in the trace has estimate error strictly less than $\tau^2/4$.
hypotheses_covered: The trace is a finite list of estimate records for dimension $n$
The target is a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
